title: Publish one drafted post now, after you approve its exact text

post.description: the drafted post: its content file, docs/marketing/content/<name>.md (the name without .md is the key the publishing skill uses)

platform.description: the platform to publish on: its name in lowercase, as the publisher and its data file are named

tasks.title: Publish the post
tasks.text: Prepare the post for the person to approve: nothing is published until the person approves the hash of its exact text, first comment and image. It is published now, once, under the key the publishing skill uses; scheduling stays with that skill.
